tagline.zh: initial-letter 让段落首字占据多行并让正文环绕(Chrome 110+/Safari 需前缀/Firefox 未支持);不支持时用 ::first-letter + float 经典兜底。
tagline.en: initial-letter makes a paragraph's first glyph span multiple lines with text wrapping around it (Chrome 110+/Safari prefixed/Firefox unsupported); the classic ::first-letter + float is the fallback.

origin.zh: 首字下沉是杂志/书籍编辑排版的传统(段首字母放大、占据多行、正文环绕)。CSS 落地:CSS Inline Layout 的 initial-letter 属性(占据行数 + 下沉行数两个整数);传统兜底为 ::first-letter + float 放大首字。浏览器支持(BCD css/properties/initial-letter.json,2026-11-22 抓取):Chrome/Edge 110+;Firefox 未支持(bugzil.la/1223880);Safari 9+ 带 -webkit- 前缀、无前缀版本未发布(WebKit bug 229090),iOS Safari 部分实现且不支持小数值(bug 296785);BCD 状态:非实验性、标准轨道。
origin.en: Drop caps are a magazine/book editorial tradition (an enlarged first glyph spanning several lines with body text wrapping). CSS lands it via CSS Inline Layout's initial-letter property (two integers: lines occupied + lines sunk); the classic fallback is ::first-letter + float. Support (BCD css/properties/initial-letter.json fetched 2026-11-22): Chrome/Edge 110+; Firefox unsupported (bugzil.la/1223880); Safari 9+ with the -webkit- prefix, unprefixed unreleased (WebKit bug 229090); iOS Safari partially implements and lacks decimal values (bug 296785); BCD status: not experimental, on the standard track.

effect.zh: 首字占据的行数(initial-letter 第一值,整数)。默认 3 行是社区常见惯例(未证实)——杂志排版常见 2–4 行;取值越大首字越高、正文环绕区越深。float 兜底方案用 calc(var(--dc-lines) * 1.1em) 近似换算字号(社区近似做法,未证实)。
effect.en: Lines the initial glyph spans (initial-letter's first integer). The default of 3 is a community convention (unverified) — magazine practice clusters at 2–4 lines; larger values make the glyph taller and the wrap zone deeper. The float fallback approximates the size via calc(var(--dc-lines) * 1.1em) (community approximation, unverified).

effect.zh: 下沉行数(initial-letter 第二值,整数)。与第一值配合形成 drop(下沉=占据行数,首字底与第 N 行正文底对齐)与 sunken(下沉 < 占据)等形态;demo 以 min(sink, lines) 钳制避免非法组合。参数语义细节以 css-inline 规范为准(本次核对到支持数据,逐字语义未核对)。
effect.en: Lines sunk below (initial-letter's second integer). Combined with the first it forms drop (sink = span) and sunken (sink < span) forms; the demo clamps with min(sink, lines) against invalid combos. Semantics per the css-inline spec (support data verified this session; wording not checked verbatim).

effect.zh: JS 型参数,demo 订阅后切换 data-technique:initial-letter 走规范属性(正文真正环绕字形,Chrome/Edge 110+ 与 Safari[-webkit-] 生效);float 走 ::first-letter + float 放大首字(全浏览器可用,但只占位不环绕字形轮廓)。Firefox 在 initial-letter 技法下经 @supports 自动退到 float。
effect.en: A JS-type param; the demo subscribes and toggles data-technique: initial-letter uses the spec property (body truly wraps the glyph; Chrome/Edge 110+ and Safari [-webkit-] apply) while float enlarges via ::first-letter + float (works everywhere but occupies a box rather than hugging the glyph). Firefox auto-falls to float under @supports in the initial-letter technique.

note.zh: initial-letter(BCD @main,2026-11-22 抓取):Chrome/Edge 110+(2023-02);Firefox 未支持(bugzil.la/1223880);Safari 9+ 需 -webkit- 前缀,无前缀版本未发布(WebKit bug 229090);iOS Safari 部分实现、不支持小数值(bug 296785)。::first-letter + float 兜底方案全浏览器可用。
note.en: initial-letter (BCD @main fetched 2026-11-22): Chrome/Edge 110+ (2023-02); Firefox unsupported (bugzil.la/1223880); Safari 9+ needs the -webkit- prefix, unprefixed unreleased (WebKit bug 229090); iOS Safari partial, no decimal values (bug 296785). The ::first-letter + float fallback works in every browser.

fallback.zh: 检测写法:@supports not ((initial-letter: 3) or (-webkit-initial-letter: 3)) 内放 ::first-letter + float 兜底(Firefox 命中,Safari 因前缀被豁免);float 方案用放大字号 + 压缩行高近似 N 行高度,是社区通行做法(近似值,未证实);initial-letter 不可用时内容仍完整可读——它纯属装饰增强。
fallback.en: Detection: put the ::first-letter + float fallback inside @supports not ((initial-letter: 3) or (-webkit-initial-letter: 3)) — Firefox matches, Safari is exempted via the prefixed form. The float approach approximates N-line height with a large font-size and compressed line-height (community practice, approximate values unverified). Without initial-letter the content stays fully readable — it is purely decorative enhancement.

use.zh: 长文特稿、杂志式文章的开篇段落——首字下沉是「正式读一篇长文」的编辑信号
use.en: Opening paragraphs of features and magazine-style pieces — a drop cap signals 'sit down and read'

use.zh: 章节化阅读产品(电子书、电子杂志)的章节首页
use.en: Chapter openers in reading products (e-books, digital magazines)

use.zh: 编辑风/报刊风设计体系的装饰排式组件(editorial-magazine 风格页)
use.en: Editorial/newspaper design systems' decorative type components (editorial-magazine-style pages)

use.zh: 多语言出版:initial-letter 对汉字首字同样生效,中西文出版共用一套机制
use.en: Multilingual publishing: initial-letter works on a leading Han glyph too — one mechanism for both scripts

avoid.zh: 短内容与卡片摘要——首字下沉在两三行的段落里没有环绕空间,只剩突兀大字
avoid.en: Short content and card summaries — a two-line paragraph leaves no room to wrap, just an awkward giant glyph

avoid.zh: 密集信息界面(表单、后台)——编辑装饰与任务效率无关还抢注意力
avoid.en: Dense task UIs (forms, dashboards) — editorial decoration steals attention from tasks

avoid.zh: 只依赖 initial-letter 而无 @supports 兜底——Firefox 用户看不到任何首字效果(可接受)或看到破碎布局(不可接受)
avoid.en: Relying on initial-letter with no @supports fallback — Firefox users see no drop cap (acceptable) or broken layout (not acceptable)

avoid.zh: 给首字加非文本修饰(背景块、图标化)破坏其「仍是文本」的可读性
avoid.en: Piling non-text decoration (background blocks, icon-ification) onto the glyph until it stops reading as text

a11y.zh: 首字下沉是纯视觉装饰:initial-letter 与 ::first-letter 都不改变 DOM 文本,屏幕阅读器朗读顺序不受影响;但要保证首字与正文有足够对比度、且放大后不与后文行重叠(initial-letter 规范处理环绕,float 方案需自己留 padding);float 方案改变首字的布局流,极端窄屏时注意首字占位是否挤压正文;对汉字首字,Safari 的对齐细节与西文有差异(ideograph 对齐,细节未逐字核对)。
a11y.en: Drop caps are purely visual: neither initial-letter nor ::first-letter touches the DOM text, so screen-reader order is unaffected. Ensure enough contrast for the enlarged glyph and no overlap with following lines (initial-letter handles wrapping per spec; the float route needs manual padding). float changes the glyph's layout flow — on very narrow screens check the placeholder doesn't squeeze the body. For a leading Han glyph Safari's alignment details differ from Latin (ideograph alignment; not verified verbatim).

goal.zh: 为文章开篇段落实现首字下沉:优先 initial-letter(占据 3 行),Firefox 用 @supports 检测后自动退到 ::first-letter + float 兜底,内容在任何浏览器都可读。
goal.en: Implement a drop cap on the article's opening paragraph: initial-letter spanning 3 lines first, auto-falling to a ::first-letter + float fallback in Firefox via @supports, readable everywhere.

acceptance.zh: initial-letter 与 -webkit-initial-letter(Safari 9–17 前缀)成对声明
acceptance.en: initial-letter and -webkit-initial-letter (Safari 9–17 prefix) declared as a pair

acceptance.zh: @supports not ((initial-letter: 3) or (-webkit-initial-letter: 3)) 内提供 float 兜底
占据行数与下沉行数使用参数快照值,不自行调整
acceptance.en: Span and sink use the exact parameter snapshot values; do not adjust

acceptance.zh: 首字放大后不与正文行重叠,float 方案自带 padding 与行高压缩
acceptance.en: The enlarged glyph never overlaps body lines; float carries its own padding and compressed line-height

acceptance.zh: 装饰不改变文本内容与朗读顺序——首字仍是原段落文本的一部分
acceptance.en: Decoration never changes the text or reading order — the glyph remains part of the original paragraph
